entries.title: Docs & videos
entries.text: Every docs and walkthrough-video job: progress, cancel, re-run with tweaks, the video player and the docs pull request.

entries.title: Docs & videos
entries.text: Opens the Docs & videos page.

entries.title: Create documentation…
entries.text: Opens Create documentation: pick built builds or single steps, the audience and depth, then it writes Markdown docs as a pull request.

entries.title: Create walkthrough video…
entries.text: Opens Create walkthrough video: pick builds, length, what to cover and how it looks; you approve the script before anything is recorded.

entries.title: Create documentation
entries.text: Writes Markdown docs from the build: Brett's words, its steps, report, diff and the screens and commands it added. Opens a PR through the merge queue.

entries.title: Create walkthrough video
entries.text: Plans a narrated click-path through the build's screens. Approve the script and the VPS records a real browser session to MP4.

entries.title: Walkthrough script
entries.text: Every scene of the planned video: the spoken line and what it shows. Edit lines or leave scenes out, then approve to record.

entries.title: Build docs
entries.text: Defaults for new docs and videos, what's running now, and install / uninstall.

entries.title: Video length (seconds)
entries.text: The length new videos start with in the dialog.

entries.title: Narration
entries.text: Narration on or off for new videos (off = silent, captions still timed).

entries.title: Captions burned in
entries.text: Burns the captions into the picture. The .vtt captions file is saved either way.

entries.title: Docs audience
entries.text: Who new docs are written for by default.

entries.title: Docs depth
entries.text: How much detail new docs have by default.

entries.title: Video viewport
entries.text: Desktop (1920×1080) or phone layout for new videos.

entries.title: Search built builds
entries.text: Filters the list of builds that have something built.

entries.title: Add builds or steps
entries.text: Shows the list of built builds and their done steps to add to this job.

entries.title: Include screenshots
entries.text: Adds screenshots of the build's screens to the docs.

entries.title: Deep mode (AI writes it)
entries.text: The AI writes the docs from the build's material. Off, or no AI provider: a template filled from the same material.

entries.title: Anything special to cover
entries.text: Free text: what the docs must cover, e.g. the right-click menu or the voice commands.

entries.title: Create documentation
entries.text: Starts the docs job. Follow it on Docs & videos; the PR link shows there when it's open.

entries.title: Audience
entries.text: Me: short and plain. Developer: files, contracts, commands. End user: how to use it, no internals.

entries.title: Depth
entries.text: Brief, Standard or Deep: how much of the build the docs go into.

entries.title: Length
entries.text: How long the video runs. The script is fitted to it.

entries.title: Custom
entries.text: Any length in seconds.

entries.title: Seconds
entries.text: The video's length in seconds (15 s to 30 min).

entries.title: Special stuff to cover
entries.text: Free text the script must cover; it's also shown as a card near the start.

entries.title: Desktop
entries.text: Records at 1920×1080 on the desktop layout.

entries.title: Phone
entries.text: Records in the phone layout (412×915), cut to 720×1600.

entries.title: Viewport
entries.text: Desktop or phone layout for the recording.

entries.title: Theme (design package)
entries.text: Records under this design package, in the recorder's browser only: the shared look on axHub never changes.

entries.title: Layout
entries.text: Records under this layout instead of the theme's own.

entries.title: Intro card
entries.text: A title card with the build's name at the start.

entries.title: Outro card
entries.text: A closing card at the end.

entries.title: Voice
entries.text: The Piper voice that narrates.

entries.title: Speed
entries.text: How fast the narration is spoken (also sets how long each scene stays).

entries.title: Deep mode (AI plans the script)
entries.text: The AI plans the click path and the lines. Off, or no AI provider: the build's screens in order.

entries.title: Plan the script
entries.text: Makes the script and opens it for your approval. Nothing is recorded yet.

entries.title: Leave this scene out
entries.text: Drops this scene from the video.

entries.title: Cancel job
entries.text: Stops the job. A recording in progress is stopped on the VPS.

entries.title: Save edits
entries.text: Saves your changes to the lines and scenes.

entries.title: Change options
entries.text: Back to the video options to plan the script again with changes.

entries.title: Approve and record
entries.text: Sends one veto call to axHub; when it runs, the VPS records the video in a heavy slot.

entries.title: Play the video
entries.text: Loads the MP4 and plays it here.

entries.title: Download MP4
entries.text: Saves the video file.

entries.title: Captions
entries.text: Saves the captions (.vtt).

entries.title: Transcript
entries.text: Saves the transcript: every spoken line by chapter.

entries.title: Read the docs here
entries.text: Shows the written Markdown on this page.

entries.title: Review the script
entries.text: Opens the planned script for edits and approval.

entries.title: Re-run with tweaks
entries.text: Opens the dialog with this job's options to change them and run it again.

entries.title: Recorder log
entries.text: Saves the VPS recorder's log for this video.

entries.title: Show
entries.text: All jobs, only docs or only videos.

entries.title: Docs
entries.text: Only docs jobs.

entries.title: Videos
entries.text: Only video jobs.

entries.title: New docs
entries.text: Opens Create documentation with nothing picked yet.

entries.title: New video
entries.text: Opens Create walkthrough video with nothing picked yet.

entries.title: Create documentation
entries.text: Right-click a built build or step anywhere builds show: writes docs for it.

entries.title: Create walkthrough video
entries.text: Right-click a built build or step anywhere builds show: plans and records a walkthrough video of it.
